chatgpt_custom_gpt.label: ChatGPT — Custom GPT
chatgpt_custom_gpt.instructions:
1. Go to platform.openai.com → "My GPTs" → "Create a GPT"
2. In the "Configure" tab, paste the content into the "Instructions" field
3. Give your GPT a name (e.g. "Brand assistant") and click "Save"
4. Share the link with your team

claude_project.label: Claude — Project
claude_project.instructions:
1. Go to claude.ai → "Projects" → "New Project"
2. Click "Set project instructions" and paste the .md file content
3. Name the project (e.g. "Brand") and invite your collaborators
4. All project conversations will inherit the system prompt

claude_skill.label: Claude — Skill
claude_skill.instructions:
CLAUDE.AI:
1. Go to claude.ai → Settings → Capabilities → Skills
2. Click "Upload skill" and select the downloaded .zip file
3. Enable the skill — Claude will invoke it automatically when relevant

CLAUDE CODE CLI:
1. Unzip the file into ~/.claude/skills/ (create the folder if needed)
2. You'll get ~/.claude/skills/<brand>/SKILL.md
3. Restart Claude Code — the skill appears in the available skills list

gemini_gem.label: Gemini — Gem
gemini_gem.instructions:
1. Go to gemini.google.com → "Gems" → "Create a Gem"
2. Paste the content into the "Instructions" field
3. Enable long memory in advanced settings
4. Save and share with your team

universal_txt.label: Universal — .txt
universal_txt.instructions:
Plain text format with no tags.
Copy the content and paste it at the start of any AI conversation (Mistral, Llama, Perplexity, etc.).
This format works with any model that accepts a system prompt or initial message.
